findings.summary: Fish completion script breaks because the three-line completion output is already split per line by `set -l response (...)`, so `string split \n` yields wrong items and `$metadata[2]`/`$metadata[3]` are empty, failing completion for every command.

judge.reason: Describes the same newline-split mismatch breaking fish completion for every command.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The string `_` is used as a sentinel for 'no help', so an option whose real help text is `_` loses its description.

judge.reason: A help text of '_' being treated as no help is a real, if minor, sentinel ambiguity in the changed code.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Newlines in help text are replaced with a literal `\n`, so Fish displays a visible backslash-n rather than a line break.

judge.reason: Replacing newlines in help with a literal \n yields visible backslash-n; plausible real defect in the changed code.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: New tests only check the Python output format and never execute the Fish script, so they pass despite the script being unable to parse the new format.

judge.reason: This says the tests don't cover the answer-key bug, which counts as valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
